legalPolicy.introduction: This Legal Policy governs the use of Pulisync and outlines the legal obligations, rights, and responsibilities of Pulisync, its users, and third-party service providers. By using Pulisync, you agree to abide by this Legal Policy in conjunction with our Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Cookie Policy. If you do not agree with any part of this Legal Policy, you must discontinue the use of Pulisync immediately.

subSectionOptionalLines.text: These policies are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of UK, without regard to its conflict of law principles.
Pulisync complies with the following regulations:

subSubsections.title: 1.2.1 Data Protection Laws
points: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (EU) – Protection of user data for European residents.
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) (USA) – Data privacy rights for California residents.
Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand) – Compliance with data security laws in Asia.
Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) (Brazil) – Ensuring compliance with Brazil's data protection regulations.

subSubsections.title: 1.2.2 Financial & Payment Security Regulations
points: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) – Secure payment transactions and fraud prevention.
Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & Know Your Customer (KYC) Regulations – Compliance with international financial laws.

subSubsections.title: 1.2.3 Consumer Protection Laws
points: Federal Trade Commission Act (USA) – Protection against deceptive practices.
E-Privacy Directive (EU) – Compliance with online tracking and cookie regulations.

optionalLines.text: Pulisync reserves the right to update compliance policies as per changing legal requirements.

subsections.title: 2.1 User Rights
points: Right to Access – Obtain a copy of your personal data stored by Pulisync.
Right to Rectification – Request correction of incorrect or incomplete data.
Right to Erasure (Right to Be Forgotten) – Request deletion of your personal data.
Right to Object – Withdraw consent for marketing and data processing.
Right to Data Portability – Transfer data to another service provider upon request.

subSectionOptionalLines.text: Requests related to user rights can be sent to hello@pulikidz.com

subsections.title: 2.2 User Responsibilities
points: Provide accurate personal and payment details.
Use the platform lawfully and refrain from fraudulent activities.
Protect account credentials from unauthorized access.
Follow applicable laws and regulations when using Pulisync.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy for Pulisync
privacyPolicy.introduction: At Pulisync, we are committed to safeguarding your privacy and protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, store, process, and share your information when you use our services.
privacyPolicy.acknowledgement: By using Pulisync, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to how we handle your data. If you do not agree, please discontinue using our services.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.description: We collect various types of personal and non-personal information to improve our platform's functionality and user experience.

subsections.title: 1.1 Personal Information
subsections.description: We collect personally identifiable information (PII) when you register, make payments, or interact with our services, including but not limited to:
points: Name (first name, last name)
Email address
Phone number
Billing and shipping address
Payment information (credit card details, digital wallet IDs, transaction history)
Institution details (school name, student details, affiliation)
Identity verification data (if required for regulatory compliance)

subsections.title: 1.2 Non-Personal Information
subsections.description: We automatically collect non-personal data through cookies, analytics tools, and log files, including:
points: Device information (IP address, browser type, OS, device model)
Usage data (pages visited, time spent, features used)
Location data (with user consent for location-based services)

subsections.title: 1.3 Data Collected from Third Parties
subsections.description: We may collect additional data from:
points: Payment providers (for successful or failed transactions)
Educational institutions (for account verification and service integration)
Third-party analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar, etc.)

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.description: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

subsections.title: 2.1 Service Delivery and Account Management
points: To create and manage user accounts
To authenticate users and enable secure logins
To facilitate financial transactions and manage payments
To provide customer support and resolve issues

subsections.title: 2.2 Communication and Notifications
points: To send account verification, payment confirmations, and security alerts
To notify users of service updates, policy changes, and technical issues
To deliver marketing communications (if consent is provided)

subsections.title: 2.3 Security and Fraud Prevention
subsections.description: We may collect additional data from:
points: To prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, and fraudulent activities
To conduct security monitoring and detect suspicious behavior
To comply with legal obligations (AML/KYC verification, if applicable)

subsections.title: 2.4 Analytics and Platform Optimization
points: To analyze user behavior and improve website functionality
To generate reports on system usage and performance
To conduct A/B testing for UI/UX enhancements

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis for Data Processing
sections.description: We process your data under the following legal grounds:

points: We process your data under the following legal grounds:
Contractual Necessity: Processing data to fulfill our service obligations.
Legitimate Interests: Analyzing usage patterns to improve the platform.
Consent: When users explicitly agree to marketing communications.
Legal Compliance: Adhering to data protection laws and financial regulations.

sections.title: 4. How We Share Your Information
sections.description: Pulisync does not sell or rent user data. We only share information under the following circumstances:

subsections.title: 4.1 With Third-Party Service Providers
points: Payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay) for secure transactions.
Hosting providers (AWS, DigitalOcean) for data storage.
Communication services (SendGrid, Twilio) for emails and SMS notifications.

subsections.title: 4.2 With Educational Institutions
subsections.subDescription: If your account is linked to a school, some data may be shared with school administrators for account management and service integration.

subsections.title: 4.3 Legal Disclosures
points: To comply with legal obligations (court orders, regulatory requirements).
To prevent fraud or security threats.

sections.title: 5. Data Security Measures
sections.description: We implement advanced security protocols to protect user data from unauthorized access, breaches, and cyber threats.

points: Encryption: AES-256 encryption for stored data and TLS 1.2 for secure data transmission.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Required for high-risk transactions.
Access Controls: Role-based access to sensitive data.
Regular Security Audits: Routine vulnerability testing and penetration testing.
Data Anonymization: Personally identifiable data is masked when not required.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention Policy
sections.description: We retain user data only for as long as necessary:

points: Account Information: Stored until user requests deletion.
Payment Records: Retained for 7 years (for regulatory compliance).
Log Files & Analytics Data: Stored for 12 months.

optionalLines.text: Users can request account deletion by contacting info@pulisync.com.

sections.title: 7. User Rights & Control
sections.description: Depending on your region, you have the following rights under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws:

points: Account Information: Stored until user requests deletion.
Payment Records: Retained for 7 years (for regulatory compliance).
Log Files & Analytics Data: Stored for 12 months.

optionalLines.text: Users can request account deletion by contacting info@pulisync.com.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.description: We use cookies and tracking tools for:

points: Essential functions: Authentication, user preferences.
Performance tracking: Google Analytics, Hotjar.
Advertising (if applicable): Google Ads, Facebook Pixel.

optionalLines.text: Users can manage cookie preferences via browser settings. For full details, see our Cookies Policy.

points: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for EU users.

learnMoreEducation.title: Empower Your Institution with Pulisync
learnMoreEducation.author: Pulisync Team
learnMoreEducation.intro: Managing an educational institution involves countless tasks, from handling administrative duties to ensuring effective communication between teachers, students, and parents. Pulisync is designed to bring all these elements together, eliminating messy spreadsheets, scattered emails, and miscommunication. By serving as a central hub, Pulisync streamlines operations and enhances collaboration for schools, teachers, parents, and students.

sections.forSchoolsTitle: For Schools: Seamless Control Over Administration
sections.forSchoolsContent: School management can be complex, but Pulisync simplifies the process by offering a fully integrated platform that covers attendance, performance tracking, payments, and scheduling. Administrators can easily oversee daily operations, ensuring everything runs smoothly without the need for multiple disconnected tools. With automated reminders and real-time updates, schools can enhance efficiency and reduce the burden of manual tasks.
sections.forTeachersTitle: For Teachers: Focus on Teaching, Not Paperwork
sections.forTeachersContent: Educators should spend more time teaching and less time on administrative work. Pulisync automates grading, attendance tracking, and communication, allowing teachers to focus on student engagement and learning outcomes. With an intuitive dashboard, teachers can access student progress reports, communicate with parents, and manage lesson plans effortlessly—all in one place.
sections.forParentsTitle: For Parents: Stay Involved in Your Child's Education
sections.forParentsContent: Pulisync keeps parents in the loop with real-time updates on their child's progress, attendance, and school events. The platform offers a convenient way to pay fees, schedule meetings, and receive notifications, ensuring they remain actively engaged in their child's education without the hassle of scattered communication.
sections.forStudentsTitle: For Students: A Smarter Way to Stay Organized
sections.forStudentsContent: From assignments and schedules to progress tracking, Pulisync helps students manage their academic responsibilities effectively. The platform consolidates all necessary information into a single dashboard, ensuring students never miss a deadline and stay on top of their coursework. By fostering organization and accountability, Pulisync empowers students to take control of their learning experience.
sections.transformContent: By bridging the gap between schools, teachers, parents, and students, Pulisync creates a collaborative and efficient educational ecosystem. Say goodbye to administrative headaches and hello to a smarter, more connected way of managing education.

learnMoreEventManagement.title: Effortless Event Management with Pulisync
learnMoreEventManagement.author: Pulisync Team
learnMoreEventManagement.intro: Managing events has never been easier. With Pulisync's powerful built-in Booking System, you can seamlessly schedule, organize, and track event reservations all in one place. Say goodbye to double bookings, lost appointments, and the hassle of manual tracking. Whether it's school functions, parent-teacher meetings, or student activities, Pulisync ensures everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

sections.stayOrganizedContent: Pulisync simplifies the entire event management process by offering a centralized platform where schools, teachers, and administrators can oversee upcoming events with ease. From scheduling important meetings to managing attendance, the system ensures that no detail is overlooked.
sections.streamlineRegistrationsContent: With automated reminders and real-time updates, Pulisync keeps everyone informed. Participants can easily browse upcoming events, register with a single click, and receive timely notifications, reducing confusion and missed appointments.
sections.enhanceEfficiencyContent: No more conflicts or last-minute changes going unnoticed. Pulisync's intelligent scheduling system prevents double bookings, allowing institutions to plan efficiently. With a well-structured interface, tracking reservations and managing event logistics becomes effortless.
sections.takeEventManagementTitle: Take Event Management to the Next Level
sections.takeEventManagementContent: Whether it's for academic workshops, extracurricular activities, or institutional meetings, Pulisync provides a streamlined, user-friendly solution that saves time and enhances coordination. Experience a smarter, more efficient way to manage events effortlessly.

learnMoreFeatures.title: Unlocking the Full Potential of Pulisync
learnMoreFeatures.author: Pulisync Team
learnMoreFeatures.intro: Education is evolving, and so should the way schools manage payments, events, and bookings. Pulisync is designed to streamline administrative processes, ensuring a seamless experience for schools, teachers, parents, and students. Let's dive into the core features that make Pulisync a game-changer in school management.

sections.flexiblePaymentsTitle: Flexible Payment Solutions - Say Goodbye to Payment Hassles
sections.flexiblePaymentsContent: Managing school fees and invoices can be a time-consuming and frustrating process. Pulisync streamlines financial transactions by offering a centralized system where schools can track all payments in one place. Parents can make payments conveniently through multiple options, including credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets. The platform also ensures that no payment goes unnoticed by sending automated reminders, keeping both parents and administrators informed. With real-time payment tracking, schools can instantly see which fees have been paid, which are pending, and which need follow-up, creating a smoother, stress-free financial process.
sections.eventManagementTitle: Comprehensive Event Management: Plan, Schedule, and Track with Ease
sections.eventManagementContent: Events play a crucial role in school life, from academic conferences to sports days and cultural programs. Pulisync makes event management seamless by allowing schools to plan, schedule, and track events in real-time. Automated invitations and reminders ensure that parents, students, and staff stay informed about upcoming activities. With built-in calendar integration, events can be synced with personal schedules to avoid conflicts, while attendance tracking helps schools monitor participation. Whether it's a school-wide seminar or a small group workshop, Pulisync ensures that everything runs smoothly.
sections.reportingInsightsTitle: Powerful Reporting & Insights: Making Data-Driven Decisions
sections.reportingInsightsContent: In an era where data plays a crucial role in decision-making, Pulisync empowers schools with powerful reporting tools. Administrators can access detailed reports on student attendance, fee collections, and event participation, allowing them to make informed choices. The platform's customizable dashboards provide a clear overview of school performance, helping educators identify trends and areas for improvement. With predictive analytics, schools can proactively address potential issues, such as declining attendance rates or irregular fee payments. More importantly, Pulisync ensures that all sensitive data remains secure, complying with the highest standards of privacy and protection.
sections.bookingSystemTitle: Seamless Booking System: Effortless Scheduling for Everyone
sections.bookingSystemContent: Coordinating parent-teacher conferences, scheduling school facilities, and managing reservations can often be a logistical nightmare. Pulisync eliminates this hassle with a seamless booking system that allows users to schedule meetings and reserve spaces with ease. Parents can book time slots for parent-teacher meetings without endless back-and-forth communication, while school staff can efficiently allocate rooms, auditoriums, and other facilities. Automated confirmations and cancellations prevent scheduling conflicts, ensuring a smooth and organized booking process.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookies Policy for Pulisync
cookiePolicy.introduction: At Pulisync, we use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve user experience, enhance platform performance, and ensure secure transactions. This Cookies Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can control your preferences.

subSectionOptionalLines.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They help websites remember user preferences, improve site performance, and enhance security.
Pulisync uses the following types of cookies:

subsections.title: 2.1 Essential Cookies (Strictly Necessary)

subSectionOptionalLines.text: These cookies are required for the platform to function correctly. Without them, certain services (e.g., secure logins, payments) may not work.

points: Authentication cookies for secure logins
Payment session cookies (to process transactions safely)
Security cookies (to prevent fraud and unauthorized access)
subsections.subDescription: Can I disable these cookies? No, because they are necessary for the basic functionality of Pulisync.

subsections.title: 2.2 Performance & Analytics Cookies

subSectionOptionalLines.text: These cookies help us understand user behavior, track website traffic, and improve site performance.

points: Google Analytics (tracks user interaction & website performance)
Hotjar (heatmaps and session recordings for UI improvements)
WebSocket session tracking (real-time data updates)
subsections.subDescription: Can I disable these cookies? Yes, you can opt out of analytics tracking in the cookie settings panel or via browser preferences.

subsections.title: 2.3 Functionality Cookies

subSectionOptionalLines.text: These cookies store user preferences (e.g., language selection, display settings) and enhance usability.

points: Remembering login details for faster access
Customizing user dashboard preferences
Retaining payment methods for one-click transactions
subsections.subDescription: Can I disable these cookies? Yes, but some preferences may reset each time you visit the site.

subsections.title: 2.4 Advertising & Marketing Cookies

subSectionOptionalLines.text: We may use cookies for personalized ads and remarketing campaigns. These cookies track user activity across websites to deliver relevant advertisements.

points: Facebook Pixel (tracks conversions from ads)
Google Ads (personalized advertising based on browsing behavior)
Retargeting cookies for abandoned cart recovery
subsections.subDescription: Can I disable these cookies? Yes, you can opt out of targeted ads via Google Ads settings, Facebook ad preferences, or our cookie settings panel.

subSectionOptionalLines.text: Some third-party providers place cookies on your device when using Pulisync. These cookies help with analytics, security, and payments.

subsections.subDescription: Examples of Third-Party Cookies Used: Google Analytics (tracks user behavior & site performance), Facebook Pixel (measures ad performance & retargeting), Stripe/PayPal (processes payments securely), Hotjar (records user interactions for UX improvements)

subSectionOptionalLines.text: You have full control over cookies and can adjust preferences anytime.

subsections.title: 4.1 Browser Settings

subSectionOptionalLines.text: You can disable or delete cookies via your web browser settings:

points: Google Chrome – Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies & Other Site Data
Mozilla Firefox – Go to Preferences → Privacy & Security → Cookies
Microsoft Edge – Go to Settings → Site Permissions → Manage Cookies
Safari (Mac/iOS) – Go to Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data

subsections.title: 4.2 Pulisync Cookie Settings Panel

subSectionOptionalLines.text: We provide an in-app cookie settings panel where you can:

points: Enable or disable non-essential cookies
Opt out of targeted ads
Adjust analytics preferences
subsections.subDescription: How to Access: Go to Pulisync Settings → Privacy → Cookie Preferences

subsections.title: 4.3 Opting Out of Advertising Cookies

subSectionOptionalLines.text: You can disable personalized ads via:

points: Google Ads Preferences: Click here
Facebook Ads Settings: Click here
Network Advertising Initiative: Click here

subSectionOptionalLines.text: Different cookies have different expiration periods:

Session Cookies (deleted when you close your browser), Persistent Cookies (30 days to 1 year varies by type), Analytics Cookies (up to 2 years Google Analytics), Marketing Cookies (90 days Facebook, Google Ads)
We ensure that our cookie usage aligns with global privacy laws:

subsections.title: 6.1 GDPR (EU Users)
points: Users must provide explicit consent before non-essential cookies are stored.
Users can withdraw consent at any time via cookie settings.

subsections.title: 6.2 CCPA (California Users)
points: Users can opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data.
A "Do Not Sell My Data" link is available in settings.

subsections.title: 6.3 Other Regional Laws
points: ePrivacy Directive (EU) – Strict consent for tracking cookies.
LGPD (Brazil) – Users must have full transparency on tracking.
PDPA (Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia) – Businesses must protect user data and provide opt-out options.

subSectionOptionalLines.text: We may update this Cookies Policy periodically to reflect changes in regulations, technology, or user preferences. If significant changes occur, we will:

points: Notify users via email or platform alerts
Update the policy date at the top of this page
Continued use of Pulisync after updates means you accept the revised policy.
